protocol: Three consecutive runs of `mise exec -- make bench-scan` on 2026-11-17 on the feat/scan-batches source (the 0.6.0 candidate) with defuss-dson 1.5.0, against the vendored defuss-dbsonl 0.5.0 package. Each figure in docs/PERFORMANCE.md is the median of the three per-run medians. The same session measured the same source on defuss-dson 1.4.0 and on 1.5.0 with the decodeFrames runs switched off (one condition in src/core/store.ts), three runs each.

runs.protocol: 100000 documents of four fields, written in batches of 5000. One untimed warmup that checks every scan returns the same count and checksum, then 7 rounds alternating the order of the three scans, each after a full garbage collection. memory: memory backend; native: native asynchronous file backend.
